sourceAccessLimits: All fifteen older-body chunks were read through EOF, with three additional complete direct body reads. Earlier actual reads persist across conversation checkpoints; hashes authenticate artifacts, not comprehension.

All twenty complete principal families were read, most recently refreshed in two bounded halves. The 415 comparison families were prepared, not all inspected: none of their seventeen rendered chunks has been read.

Principal families are included within prepared comparison totals, not additional families. Older complete articles supply additional cited comparison evidence without implying complete family inspection.

The original210 navigation candidates and the112 selected older bodies have different scope. Three later direct bodies raise the actual union to115; neither preparation nor navigation counts as body inspection.
All33 component records and the two related N2 kanji bodies were actually read. Missing 塞/無/沙/汰/襖/附/属/蓋/騒 cards are not inspected bodies and cannot become links.
All20 public captures were inspected for applicable lexical headings from one authority. Homographs, historical readings, character entries and historical senses are not automatically imported.
Applicable confusable-inventory principles were consulted. Exclusions remain symmetric pairwise hypotheses, not transitive cliques, dictionary synonym claims or automatic rules for all related words.
Actual author inspection is not independent reviewer evidence, global quiz uniqueness, native certification, etymological proof or measured model-bias reduction.

quizGuardRationale: Direct pairwise hypotheses, not reviewer findings. Actual full labels and ordinary senses in both directions matter; no transitive closure, POS exemption or blanket category exclusion.
符号 compares actual sign/mark/symbol/code labels, without asserting natural indications and representational symbols are unrestricted synonyms.
夫妻 and夫婦 overlap in married couple despite register/self-reference differences. 父母 separately compares両親 and親; a pre-existing edge does not protect a new pair.

塞がる compares blocked/closed/occupied/healed states and availability; 塞ぐ separately compares physical plugging, obstructing, occupying and low mood. Neither ending nor loose English gloss decides conjugation.
ふざける compares jokes/pranks/teasing/play and ridicule, not every laughter event. 無沙汰 compares ordinary long lack of contact with broader neglect and communication loss, not every long interval.
襖 compares actual door/screen labels including障子, despite architectural differences. 部首 remains an indexing radical, not every component or portion.
附属 compares attachment/affiliation/belonging, not only physical sticking. 蓋 compares actual lid/closure/cover labels, not every book cover.
不通 compares interruption/stoppage/contact loss; malfunction can be a cause rather than a synonym. 普通 is an unrelated homophone, not a guard.

Bothぶつ verbs independently compare collision/hitting ordinary senses. ぶつかる additionally compares meetings, conflicting opinions, simultaneous events and confronting; ぶつける compares throwing and directed expression. Deliberateness and transitivity alone do not settle bare-title ambiguity.

物騒 compares actual danger and unsettled senses, not mere sound volume. ぶつぶつ separately compares complaints, low speech, spots and simmering; the completeもぐもぐ family additionally supports mumbling, not an inferred complaint sense.

船便 compares broader service/mail, not every correspondence item. 部品 compares broad part/component labels despite assembled-product focus. 吹雪 compares storm while maintaining wind-driven snow rather than every snowfall.
